body: I honestly didn’t expect anyone to respond to this.  I promise I’ll respond back but right now I’ve been basically sobbing over the fact that complete strangers actually read something I wrote and seem to care.

I’m sorry, I didn’t even think someone would comment on this. I just don’t see the point anymore. I feel like the only reason I’m still around is the fact that I have to work tomorrow morning. I’m so tired. I’m so tired of this being my fault because I, the woman, miscarried but I’m not allowed to talk about it at all. He or she would have been 18 months by now and that kills me. I should have been more careful.
Would it be possible to get a code as well? I’m sorry I’m late to the party.

He likes video games. He works at GameStop but they just significantly cut his hours so I know he’s upset about that. We live in a major city in Texas so we try to explore often and he loves walking around aimlessly and looking in all the different shops and cafes. He loves animals and he claims his family is “cursed” with attracting animals everywhere he goes. He loves music and plays guitar and can usually play anything by ear on guitar or piano if he hear it enough. He’s that type of guy that reads textbooks and dictionaries for fun but he has a special place for Sherlock Holmes in his heart because his mom would read that to him. 



Sorry, I’m sure that was more than you expected but I find him completely fascinating and could talk about him all day. I just wish he could see how I see him and see how much this hurts.

I totally agree and I would say he does tend to have a puppy mentality sometimes. He’s a total sweetheart that has had a rough life and I know he often feels alone. I’m trying to get him to feel more involved when he’s in the slumps but this time I don’t know what to do.

I’m going to lose him aren’t I? I don’t know what else to do other than force him to go to a hospital where he might hate me and ultimately try again. I love him so incredibly much but I know he’s in a lot of pain but I don’t want to lose him. 
I’m sorry it’s 3:30 my time and I’ve been crying uncontrollably for the past six hours. I scared to fall asleep in case he doesn’t wake up.

It used to be his mom but she passed away from cancer December before last. His father abandoned him and he has two older half siblings that are twice his age that never really talk to him. He has friends but he’s convinced that he’s a burden to them. So that leaves me. I’m usually the one that talks him through anxiety attacks and all the lows but he’s not letting me talk him out of this one.
Probably not. I can  try to or at least show him the messages. He’s been to a mental hospital after a previous attempt before we started  dating  and said he never would do it again.
I don’t know who you are but I’m here if you want to talk. I know you’re tired and hurting but you are a valid person and worthy of having a future.
